D.t: Maxine Dexter leads by 62.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 212,975 votes; a one point swing is about 1,701 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +56.4 and D +68.3. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
Registered Democrats cast 46% of the 489,294 ballots in Oregon so far, against 29% for the other party. That is 8.5 points better for Democrats than the forecast expected by now.
